indication: prevent further recurrences of genital herpes
shorten the duration for healing shingles
halt the formation of more lesions and further spread of the virus
pharmaceutical_form: capsule || tablet || liquid suspension || injection || powder || ointment
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: 400mg thrice daily for a total of five days
800mg thrice daily for a total of two days
800mg twice a day for a total of five days
dosage_frequency: once daily || twice a day || every 8 hours
mechanism_of_action: prevents the division and multiplication of viruses responsible for said infections by incorporating into new virus in DNA, stopping production of DNA
side_effects: seizures || hepatitis || agitation || hypersensitivity reaction || muscle pain || anemia
